new_people.name: Will Harris
new_people.how: Held over - the April 2020 election was postponed by the COVID-19 shutdown, so the sitting president stayed in office into the following autumn.
new_people.note: SGA voted on 20 April 2020 to postpone its spring elections until the autumn and to add an emergency clause to its constitution. Harris, elected in April 2019 for 2019-20, was still SGA president when the senate met for the first time since April on 15 September 2020, and again at the meeting of 22 September 2020, where he gave the update on the coming election. He is a fill-in for the first month of 2020-21 and would not appear on that year's plaque plate.

src.label: College Heights Herald, 16 Sep 2020 and 22 Sep 2020

new_people.name: J. Garrett Edmonds
new_people.how: Elected in the delayed general election announced on 29-30 September 2020, then took office at the start of October.
new_people.note: SGA announced the results of the postponed election at a virtual party over Zoom, where the Edmonds-Norvell ticket beat MJ Mayo for the presidency. Edmonds was described as SGA president in the Herald from 6 October 2020 and presented the budget as president at the senate's first official meeting of the year on 6 October 2020. He held the office through the spring, addressing the delayed Class of 2021 commencement in May.

src.label: College Heights Herald, 30 Sep 2020 and 7 Oct 2020

note: This is the mid-year change the plaque cannot show. The 2020-21 year opened under the previous year's president because COVID-19 pushed the election from April to the end of September. Only Edmonds carries the year on the plaque; Harris presided over the first two senate meetings of the year.
